# MCP Environment Variables Reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-env-reference.ts — do not edit by hand. -->
<!-- Run `pnpm --filter @mindvault/mcp generate-env-reference` to regenerate. -->

Every environment variable the MindVault MCP server reads, generated from
[`mcp/src/envReference.ts`](../mcp/src/envReference.ts) — the single source
of truth for names, defaults, and accepted values. Defaults are imported
from the module that enforces them, so this page cannot drift from what
the code actually applies.

For the server-side (non-MCP) variables, see
[environment-variables.md](environment-variables.md), which remains the
prose-level explanation of deployment configuration.

**38 variables** as of last generation.

| Variable | Description | Default | Accepted values | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `STELLAR_NETWORK` | Deployment target for the MCP server. Selects the registry-client network preset (RPC and Horizon URLs, passphrase, USDC contract). | testnet | testnet · mainnet · pubnet · public | `mcp/src/config.ts` |
| `MINDVAULT_URL` | Base URL of the MindVault API the catalog tools browse and buy from. | the built-in production default (see mcp/src/config.ts) | — | `mcp/src/config.ts` |
| `VAULT_REGISTRY_CONTRACT_ID` | Vault-registry Soroban contract id used for on-chain lookups and mutations. Falls back to the network preset's canonical deployment. | the network preset's default contract id (empty when the preset defines none) | — | `mcp/src/config.ts` |
| `NETWORK` | x402 payment network id. Defaults to the preset for the selected Stellar network. | the preset's x402 network (stellar:testnet or stellar:pubnet) | stellar:testnet · stellar:pubnet | `mcp/src/config.ts` |
| `SPONSORED_ACCOUNT_URL` | Sponsored-account service used for wallet creation without agent funds. | the built-in production default (see mcp/src/config.ts) | — | `mcp/src/config.ts` |
| `USDC_CONTRACT_ID` | Overrides the USDC token contract for buy/settlement flows. Defaults to the network preset's canonical USDC SAC id; a non-preset override is reported as a startup warning. | the network preset's USDC SAC contract id | — | `mcp/src/index.ts` |
| `HORIZON_URL` | Horizon endpoint for balance and account reads. Falls back to the preset. | the network preset's Horizon URL | — | `mcp/src/config.ts` |

| `MINDVAULT_SOROBAN_RPC_URLS` | Comma-separated failover list of Soroban RPC endpoints in priority order. Overrides SOROBAN_RPC_URL when set. | unset — single endpoint from SOROBAN_RPC_URL / the preset | — | `mcp/src/rpcFailover.ts` |
| `MINDVAULT_RPC_FAILOVER_COOLDOWN_MS` | How long a failed Soroban endpoint is skipped before it is retried. | 30000 (ms) | — | `mcp/src/rpcFailover.ts` |
| `MINDVAULT_RPC_FAILOVER_MAX_ATTEMPTS` | Endpoint tries per call during failover. 0 tries every configured endpoint. | 0 (unlimited) | — | `mcp/src/rpcFailover.ts` |
| `MINDVAULT_ALLOW_MAINNET` | Operator-side unlock for mainnet mutations. Parsed fail-safe: only the documented opt-in spellings widen the policy, anything else — including an unexpanded template placeholder — keeps per-call confirmation (#606). A set-but-ineffective value raises a startup warning. | per-call-confirm | unset/0/false/no/off → per-call-confirm · 1/true/yes → allow-all | `mcp/src/mainnetGuardrails.ts` |
| `MINDVAULT_READ_ONLY` | Restrict the server to read-only tools. Only tools whose definition declares readOnlyHint are advertised, and the dispatcher refuses every other tool even for clients holding a cached tool list. | unset (full surface) | 1 · true · yes · on | `mcp/src/readOnlyMode.ts` |

| `MINDVAULT_MAX_AUTO_PAY_USDC` | Ceiling for the automatic x402 settlement inside mindvault_buy. A purchase above the ceiling needs a per-call maxAutoPayUsdc at least equal to the price. | 10 USDC | — | `mcp/src/paymentCeiling.ts` |

| `MINDVAULT_CATALOG_CACHE_MAX_AGE_MS` | Age past which an offline snapshot is withheld entirely. 0 keeps the pre-#573 behaviour of always serving, labelled when old. Clamped up to the TTL when set lower. | 0 (never withhold) | — | `mcp/src/catalogCache.ts` |
| `MINDVAULT_PREVIEW_MAX_BYTES` | Byte ceiling for a serialized mindvault_preview response; 0 disables. Values below the 1024 floor are raised to it. | 8192 (bytes) | — | `mcp/src/previewLimits.ts` |
| `MINDVAULT_PREVIEW_FIELD_MAX_CHARS` | Character ceiling for each free-text preview field (title, description); 0 disables. | 1000 (chars) | — | `mcp/src/previewLimits.ts` |
| `MINDVAULT_PURCHASES_FILE` | Path of the purchase-receipt file mindvault_buy appends to. | ~/.mindvault/purchases.json | — | `mcp/src/purchaseHistory.ts` |

| `MINDVAULT_HORIZON_TIMEOUT_MS` | Request deadline for Horizon balance/account reads. 0 disables. | 15000 (ms) | — | `mcp/src/httpTimeout.ts` |
| `MINDVAULT_SOROBAN_TIMEOUT_MS` | Request deadline for Soroban RPC calls. 0 disables. | 20000 (ms) | — | `mcp/src/httpTimeout.ts` |

| `MINDVAULT_TOOL_TIMEOUTS` | Per-tool timeout overrides as a comma/space-separated list of tool=milliseconds entries. The mindvault_ prefix is optional; 0 removes the deadline for that tool. | unset — every tool uses its service budget | — | `mcp/src/toolTimeoutOverrides.ts` |

| `MINDVAULT_RETRY_ATTEMPTS` | Total attempts (including the first) for idempotent calls. 1 disables retrying. Never applies to payments. | 3 | — | `mcp/src/retry.ts` |
| `MINDVAULT_RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MS` | Backoff delay before the first retry; doubles each attempt. | 250 (ms) | — | `mcp/src/retry.ts` |

| `MINDVAULT_RETRY_ATTEMPTS_<TOOL>` | Per-tool retry overrides, derived from the global names by suffixing the uppercased tool name — e.g. MINDVAULT_RETRY_ATTEMPTS_MINDVAULT_BROWSE=5 for mindvault_browse. | unset — the global retry policy applies | — | `mcp/src/retry.ts` |
| `MINDVAULT_METRICS` | Opt-in per-tool metrics (call/error counts, durations, budget overruns). Output contains tool names and counts only. | unset (disabled) | 1 · true · yes · on | `mcp/src/metrics.ts` |

| `MINDVAULT_AUDIT_LOG_FILE` | Append audit entries to this file as JSON Lines (in addition to stderr), with size-based rotation. | unset — file sink off, stderr only | — | `mcp/src/auditLogRotation.ts` |
| `MINDVAULT_AUDIT_LOG_MAX_BYTES` | Rotate the audit log file once it would exceed this size. Floor of 1024 bytes. | 5242880 (bytes) | — | `mcp/src/auditLogRotation.ts` |
| `MINDVAULT_AUDIT_LOG_MAX_FILES` | Rotated audit-log generations kept besides the live file. | 4 (files) | — | `mcp/src/auditLogRotation.ts` |
